doc.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022

title: Jam sessions and sitting in
summary: Blue says there are fewer places to jam, but musicians should still go out and sit in.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Excuse me. There aren’t as many opportunities for musicians to go out to jam. There used to be a lot more. There’s still some, but you’ve got to get out and play with cats. You know. Even now, you go places, you go play man and it’s important. I’ll finish a gig and then find out where cats are playing a little later, you know, and go and listen or just go sit in. And then yeah, you hear how cats are handling the language man. Yeah.
